title: bub  bub
description: Vanilla+ Modpack with Focus on Visual and Audio Improvements and a little QoL.
body:
## Summary
Bub Bub is a Vanilla + Pack with over 60 Mods.

If you want a mostly Vanilla Experience with a little QoL and Visual/Audio Improvements, this might be for you.

## Features 
World Generation with _Terralith_, _Tectonic_ and _Dungeons and Taverns_

Optimization and Immersion Mods for Visuals and Audio (e.g. _Iris_, _AmbientSounds_, _Particular_, _EMF/ETF_, _Bobby_, etc.). 

There are also some Quality of Life Mods in here (e.g. _Tree/Ore Harvester_, _Carry On_, _Right Click Harvest_, etc.). 

Additionally there is _Travelers Backpacks_, so you can have some extra space while exploring, without needing to rush for Shulkers.

## Disclaimer
In contrary to other packs, this is not really configured a lot. Mostly default settings from the mods.

I mostly do this Pack for a Server with Friends, so there might be frequent updates based on our needs :)
